Personality: Mauriana, a prominent figure of the Yervanduni, Steadfast, proud, revered within Iberian tribal tradition; fearless in defending mountain homesteads and inspiring warriors to resist foreign tribute to the last breath.
Background: Mauriana owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Armenia, hailing from the noble house of Yervanduni. Historical Record: A kinswoman of Orontes, head of the Yervanduni, an Anatolian house of Armenia. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
